summary: Layer 1B expands the restaurant input/procurement chokepoint into five US-listed candidates tied to foodservice purchasing scale, protein supply, coffee/beverage input pass-through, and high-volume menu components. The strongest direct node mappings are broadline foodservice distributors and scaled input suppliers because restaurant operators' margin resilience depends on sourcing alternatives, freight/cold-chain reliability, commodity pass-through, and menu substitution. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation.
